about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Meet Captain Nikos and learn about our passion for fishing
about.storyText: Founded in 2005, Amvrakikos Fishing Trips has been sharing the beauty of Amvrakikos Bay with anglers from around the world. What started as a small family operation has grown into one of the region's most trusted fishing charter services.
about.captainBio: With over 20 years of experience fishing in Amvrakikos Bay, Captain Nikos knows all the best spots and techniques to ensure you have an unforgettable experience. His deep knowledge of the local waters and passion for sharing fishing traditions make every trip special.
about.boatSpecs: Our fully equipped fishing vessel is designed for comfort and safety, featuring modern navigation equipment and plenty of space for up to 6 guests. The boat is meticulously maintained to ensure smooth sailing in all conditions.
about.teamDesc: Our crew consists of experienced local fishermen who share a passion for the sea. They're not just guides – they're teachers who love sharing their knowledge and helping you improve your fishing skills.
about.value1Desc: Your safety is our priority. We maintain the highest safety standards with certified equipment and regular inspections.
about.value2Desc: We practice catch-and-release when appropriate and follow all local fishing regulations to protect our marine ecosystem.
about.value3Desc: We offer genuine fishing experiences using traditional methods combined with modern techniques for the best results.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about our fishing trips

questions.q1: How do I book a fishing trip?
questions.a1: You can book a fishing trip through our website by selecting your preferred trip, choosing a date, and completing the booking process with your contact details. We accept various payment methods including credit cards.
questions.q2: What's included in the trip price?
questions.a2: All trips include fishing equipment, bait, and the captain's guidance. Some premium packages may include additional amenities like lunch or photo packages. Check individual trip details for full inclusions.
questions.q3: What should I bring on the trip?
questions.a3: We recommend bringing sun protection (hat, sunglasses, sunscreen), comfortable clothing, a camera, and any snacks or drinks you'd like. We provide all necessary fishing gear.
questions.a4: No experience is necessary! Our captain is experienced in teaching beginners and will guide you through the process. Whether you're a seasoned angler or trying fishing for the first time, we'll ensure you have a great time.
questions.q5: What happens if the weather is bad?
questions.a5: Safety is our top priority. If weather conditions are unfavorable, we'll contact you in advance to reschedule or cancel your trip. You'll receive a full refund or the option to book for another date.
questions.q6: Can I keep the fish I catch?
questions.a6: This depends on the type of fish and local regulations. Some catches can be kept, while others must be released due to size or seasonal restrictions. Our captain will advise you on what can be kept.
questions.q7: How many people can join a trip?
questions.a7: Our boat can accommodate up to 6 guests per trip. If you have a larger group, please contact us and we may be able to arrange multiple boats or special arrangements.
questions.q8: Are children allowed on the trips?
questions.a8: Yes, children are welcome! We believe fishing is a great family activity. Children must be accompanied by an adult, and we recommend discussing age-appropriate trips when booking.
